ideas.title: The Impact of Minnesota's Welfare Fraud Investigation on Low-Income Families
ideas.description: Investigate the impact of the welfare fraud investigation on low-income families in Minnesota, including the potential consequences of the funding freeze.
questions: How many families will be affected?
What are the potential consequences of the funding freeze?
ideas.insight: The investigation into welfare fraud in Minnesota has the potential to significantly impact low-income families, who rely on these services to get by. Further investigation is needed to understand the scope of the impact and potential consequences.

ideas.title: The Trump Administration's Role in the Freeze on Child Care Funding
ideas.description: Investigate the Trump administration's role in the freeze on child care funding for 5 Democratic states, including the motivations behind the decision.
questions: What were the motivations behind the decision?
How will this impact vulnerable populations?
ideas.insight: The Trump administration's decision to freeze child care funding for 5 Democratic states has sparked controversy and concern. Further investigation is needed to understand the motivations behind this decision and its potential consequences.
